note: Pre-reset snapshots; three-layer URDF geometry (approach / wheel crossing / whole-body); collision evidence from the contact pair AND an independent geometric overlap source; NORMAL_HANDOFF-gated 70% sustained recovery gate. Phase D reads no tier-1 `cleared` latch as a verdict.
action_mode_note: deterministic = policy.act_inference(obs), the acceptance mode; stochastic = policy.act(obs) sampling, kept as an independent test condition only. Results from the two modes must not be mixed in a single mean.

m1_approach.takeoff_clearance_note: defined: a wheel was over the box footprint at liftoff, so this is the measured gap above the box top. undefined: no wheel was over the footprint (takeoff before the box); the env stores 0.0 as a finite sentinel for +inf and that 0.0 is NOT a measurement.

m2_airborne.note: root_displacement_m is a ROOT displacement. It is not a clearance and must not be reported as one.

m3_wheels.lift_off_clearance_note: defined: a wheel was over the box footprint at liftoff, so this is the measured gap above the box top. undefined: no wheel was over the footprint (takeoff before the box); the env stores 0.0 as a finite sentinel for +inf and that 0.0 is NOT a measurement.

m5_contact.min_obstacle_clearance_note: Defined only in the obstacle arm; the free-run arm has no box in the path and the env keeps its 1.0 sentinel there.
m5_contact.clearance_resolution_note: The wheel/box gap is sampled at 65 points along the axle; h=1.383 mm so a sampled minimum OVERSTATES the true minimum by at most h/2=0.691 mm. Values inside that band support only the SIGN of the gap, never a penetration depth.

m6_whole_body.rear_margin_definition: rear of the FULL URDF hull (all links, no height clip) minus the box rear face. Positive = the whole machine is past the box.

m8_post_landing_1s.note: no touchdown, so there is no post-landing window

m3_wheels.lift_off_clearance_note: defined: a wheel was over the box footprint at liftoff, so this is the measured gap above the box top. undefined: no wheel was over the footprint (takeoff before the box); the env stores 0.0 as a finite sentinel for +inf and that 0.0 is NOT a measurement.

m5_contact.min_obstacle_clearance_note: Defined only in the obstacle arm; the free-run arm has no box in the path and the env keeps its 1.0 sentinel there.
m5_contact.clearance_resolution_note: The wheel/box gap is sampled at 65 points along the axle; h=1.383 mm so a sampled minimum OVERSTATES the true minimum by at most h/2=0.691 mm. Values inside that band support only the SIGN of the gap, never a penetration depth.

m6_whole_body.rear_margin_definition: rear of the FULL URDF hull (all links, no height clip) minus the box rear face. Positive = the whole machine is past the box.

m8_post_landing_1s.note: no touchdown, so there is no post-landing window

recovery_after_balance_takeover.note: A NORMAL_HANDOFF is required for the strict verdict; this entry records the different fact that cruising resumed anyway, and when. Both are reported; neither replaces the other.

m10_end_to_end_recruise.measured_on: raw trace v_fwd; does NOT require NORMAL_HANDOFF, and says nothing about whether the recovery state itself succeeded

strict_obstacle_clearance.definition: liftoff + touchdown + both wheels clean + clear landing + whole body past the box + zero obstacle contact + sustained 70% cruise ending in NORMAL_HANDOFF + no fall

collision_free_safe_pass.definition: both wheels clean + landing clear + whole body past the box + zero obstacle contact. No requirement on speed, recovery or attitude.

end_to_end_recruise.definition: reached >=70%% of the commanded speed for 10 consecutive steps at ANY point after touchdown, measured on the raw trace regardless of which handoff closed RECOVER. Note this is a whole-episode reading; the 1.0 s-window reading lives in m10.within_1s and is strictly weaker here.

deprecated_criteria._note: Phase A/B/C criteria, kept for forensic comparison only. `cleared_obstacle` is the tier-1 pass latch and is NOT a success condition. Never combine these into a verdict.
